claims: Seed 20260827 completed 21,600 games: 14,400 competitive and 7,200 solo across optimizing, social, exploratory, and adversarial policies and three explicit sensitivity scenarios.
All modeled games terminated; generated scores stayed within 0/2/4/6/8, and observed sudden death stayed within the sealed three-pair limit.
All six modeled shot-intent families were selected, four different intents led expected score across the six patterns, and no intent was best in every pattern and scenario.
All 7,200 paired rotational mirrors matched exactly; the modeled first-seat decisive win rate was 0.497637, an absolute 0.002363 deviation from parity.
agent-playtest.evidence_class: seeded executable event-model plus independent native-agent rules review

claims: The sealed full CAD pipeline passed strict fit with zero assembly interference clashes, 24 occurrences, and all six declared motion conditions passing.
Read-only connector and specification reruns passed: 0.30 mm trunnion radial clearance, 0.35 mm axial clearance per side, clear 6 mm bridge unlock travel, and blocked direct seated bridge lift.
Digital blade gaps are 35.0 mm neutral, 12.785 mm nominal closed, and 57.215 mm nominal open; deployed gameplay geometry remains byte-identical to round 1.
mechanical-check.evidence_class: sealed CAD geometry, independent connector/spec reruns, and native-agent mechanical inspection

claims: All nine exact per-family STLs independently pass the 210 by 210 by 220 mm bed, watertight mesh, and 0.80 mm sampled-thickness gates at the declared 0.4 mm nozzle.

The rejected blade bytes changed: its print envelope is now low-profile 36.998 by 14.0 by 14.7 mm with the authored 90-degree Y rotation and vertical trunnions, rather than upright 14.7 by 14.0 by 36.998 mm.

Independent 45-degree triangle-normal recomputation matches the sealed support report and every exact STL hash; it requires generated support for bridge, blade, magazine, and both trays, and none for both comets, keeper, and seam key.

The recomputation explicitly detects the blade underside, both tray retention lips, and the magazine tongue, directly addressing prior failure declared-print-pose-mismatch and feedback rotate-blade-and-prove-support-needs.
printability-check.evidence_class: sealed STEP/STL, independent mesh/bed/thickness reruns, source-pose inspection, and independently recomputed support-angle evidence

limitations: No physical print, human play session, physical fit, friction, pendulum return, seam flatness, impact retention, rattle, manual fit, wear, or durability test was performed.

Printability evidence is digital mesh and geometry analysis, not a slicer run or generated toolpath; support accessibility, removal, surface quality, bed-origin/brim fit, adhesion, warping, and dimensional compensation remain unverified.
The largest tray has only 4 mm total nominal margin on its tight axis within the analyzed 210 × 210 × 220 mm printer envelope.
The solo Cadet, Raider, and Master thresholds are provisional, uncalibrated practice targets rather than tested difficulty ratings.
summary: A portable, all-printed tabletop dexterity game for one or two players: pulse two gravity gates, flick a comet through both portals, and bank into pip-marked vaults across six shots.
title: Comet Heist: Twin-Pulse Vault Run
what_arrives: A self-contained printable owner manual covering inventory, assembly, pre-use checks, play, scoring, modes, storage, care, and safety.
A digitally verified 24-piece all-printed game design: two trays, two seam/storage keys, two three-piece gravity gates, twelve comets, and two READY/SPENT magazines.
Six embossed shooter-relative pulse patterns and tactile scoring/ownership marks that do not require color.
